description: This file defines the HeaderProcessor class which provides a static method to parse HTTP headers, extracting version, status code, reason phrase, and headers from an array of header lines.

classes.name: HeaderProcessor
classes.description: A final utility class responsible for parsing HTTP header lines into structured components.

methods.name: parseHeaders
methods.description: Parses an array of HTTP header lines to extract HTTP version, status code, reason phrase, and headers; throws exceptions if mandatory parts are missing.
